description:
Convert an amount

`amount` of `from` in `to` at the official rate on `date` (default: latest). TCMB is used when it publishes both currencies (TRY included), else ECB (EUR included). With TCMB, `rateType` picks the rate each currency is valued at in TRY: `mid` (default, the forex buying/selling midpoint), `buying` or `selling`. Use to convert an amount between currencies at the official rate, e.g. 100 USD in TRY or 50 EUR in USD.

GET /v1/fx/conversions on Currencies (SBX-FX). Costs 1 credit per call.
name: fx_convertCurrency
title: Currencies: Convert an amount
